title: SHARP: Unlocking Interactive Hallucination via Stance Transfer in Role-Playing LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the sycophancy rate (agreeing with counterfactual claims) and adversary rate (disagreeing with factual claims) of a protagonist role-playing LLM toward other characters based on their predefined affection levels or social relationships.

Comparing the model's stance transfer, specifically sycophancy and adversary rates, when interacting with claims in English versus Chinese to observe differing cultural behavioral patterns (e.g., conservative vs. open).
